web.scope: Searched on 13.11.2026. Sources: Hacker News comments, Hugging Face discussions, issues of Ollama, QwenLM, resemble-ai/chatterbox and mlx-audio (now `Neywa-Labs/mlx-audio`). **Reddit could not be read.** Items from before 13.05.2026 that are not launch discussions are marked "older". Released 30.01.2026; window: since 13.05.2026 plus the launch.
web.summary: Liked for speed and tables; Ollama is the weak point (loops, context); FR/DE untested.
web.verdict: Liked for speed and tables; Ollama loops and too-small default context (set num_ctx); FR/DE untested

comments.text: On Ollama, output loops forever, still open ([ollama#16892, 24.06.2026](https://github.com/ollama/ollama/issues/16892)); Ollama 0.35.1 broke table recognition ([ollama#18810, 05.10.2026](https://github.com/ollama/ollama/issues/18810)).

Ollama's default context (4096) is too small: empty output or crash; set `num_ctx` to about 10240 ([HF #8, 06.02.2026](https://huggingface.co/zai-org/GLM-OCR/discussions/8); [ollama#16696, 12.06.2026](https://github.com/ollama/ollama/issues/16696)).
Z.ai says languages other than Chinese and English are not yet fully optimised: a warning for French and German accents ([HF #41, 25.02.2026](https://huggingface.co/zai-org/GLM-OCR/discussions/41)).
Does much better than Claude, on modest hardware ([llm_nerd, 05.09.2026](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49577756)).
Slightly less accurate than Datalab Chandra, but faster; PaddleOCR clearly worse ([phenomen, 24.08.2026](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49421088)).
